FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Monsieur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. well
   B. Sir, Mr
   C. good evening
   D. yes

2. How do you say 'Hi, Kamau!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Oui, ça va.
   B. Bonsoir, Madame !
   C. Salut, Kamau !
   D. Comment tu t'appelles ?

3. How do you say 'Here is my grandmother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   B. C'est ma mère.
   C. Voici ma grand-mère.
   D. Voici ma famille.

4. How do you say 'It is the baby.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici ma famille.
   B. C'est ma sœur.
   C. Mon père s'appelle David.
   D. C'est le bébé.

5. How do you say 'Where is the cat?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   C. Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   D. Où est le chat ?

6. How do you say 'Here is my house.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une table.
   B. C'est un lit.
   C. Voici ma maison.
   D. Où est le chat ?

7. What does 'je me repose' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. I sing
   B. tomorrow
   C. today
   D. I rest

8. What does 'le jour' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the school
   B. the day
   C. the church
   D. the week

9. What number is 'douze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 9
   D. 17

10. How do you say 'I am nine years old.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai neuf ans.
   B. Joyeux anniversaire !
   C. C'est le premier janvier.
   D. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.

11. Which month is 'mai'? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. December
   C. February
   D. May

12. Which month is 'juillet'? (1 mark)
   A. July
   B. May
   C. March
   D. October

13. What does 'la tomate' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. bread
   C. the tomato
   D. rice

14. What does 'le lait' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cheese
   B. milk
   C. the cake
   D. chips

15. What does 'le genou' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the knee
   B. the ear
   C. the stomach
   D. the finger

16. What does 'la tête' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the neck
   B. the head
   C. the tooth
   D. the mouth

17. What does 'Il y a des nuages.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is freezing.
   B. It is raining.
   C. The weather is nice.
   D. It is cloudy.

18. What does 'le soleil' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sun
   B. the snow
   C. the weather
   D. a flood

19. What does 'la clé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the shop
   B. the key
   C. the rug
   D. the garden

20. What does 'le magasin' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the key
   B. the garden
   C. the shop
   D. the rug

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how to stay safe in harsh weather such as a storm. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. List four rooms in a house in French. (4 marks) (4 marks)

23. Write five parts of the body in French with le, la or les. (5 marks) (5 marks)

24. Write a short dialogue asking what day it is and answering. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Write a short greeting dialogue of four lines in French between two friends who meet in the morning. Include their names. (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. Write a short dialogue asking for directions to the school. (4 marks) (4 marks)

27. Explain the difference between mon and ma. Give one example of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

28. Write three sentences about foods you like and do not like in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Sir, Mr
   Monsieur means Sir, Mr.

2. C — Salut, Kamau !
   Hi, Kamau! in French is Salut, Kamau !

3. C — Voici ma grand-mère.
   Here is my grandmother. in French is Voici ma grand-mère.

4. D — C'est le bébé.
   It is the baby. in French is C'est le bébé.

5. D — Où est le chat ?
   Where is the cat? in French is Où est le chat ?

6. C — Voici ma maison.
   Here is my house. in French is Voici ma maison.

7. D — I rest
   je me repose means I rest.

8. B — the day
   le jour means the day.

9. A — 12
   douze means 12.

10. A — J'ai neuf ans.
   I am nine years old. in French is J'ai neuf ans.

11. D — May
   mai means May.

12. A — July
   juillet means July.

13. C — the tomato
   la tomate means the tomato.

14. B — milk
   le lait means milk.

15. A — the knee
   le genou means the knee.

16. B — the head
   la tête means the head.

17. D — It is cloudy.
   Il y a des nuages. means It is cloudy..

18. A — the sun
   le soleil means the sun.

19. B — the key
   la clé means the key.

20. C — the shop
   le magasin means the shop.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay inside a strong building, stay away from tall trees and water, and listen to adults.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each safety point.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: la chambre, le salon, la cuisine, la salle de bain
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct room with le or la.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: la tête, les yeux, le nez, la bouche, la main
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its article.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ? Aujourd'hui, c'est mardi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for aujourd'hui and 1 mark for a correct day.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour, Amina ! Salut, Kamau ! Comment tu t'appelles ? Je m'appelle Amina. (any correct four-line dialogue)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for a question, 1 mark for je m'appelle with a name, 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Merci ! De rien !
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for excusez-moi question, 1 mark for the instructions and 1 mark for merci and de rien.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mon is used before masculine words, for example mon père. Ma is used before feminine words, for example ma mère.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for each example.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'aime la mangue. J'aime le lait. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.
